environment: **Arkonex DEV host**: this machine is a dedicated DEVELOPMENT server for the Arkonex ERPNext apps (Linux user `frappe`, bench at `/home/frappe/frappe-bench`). Development and production are strictly separated environments.

**Arkonex DEV data**: the Frappe site `deverp.arkonex.ca` on this host, and isolated test benches whose sites end in `.local`, hold no customer data and no real transactions. Until the first authorized production release they serve only for development (owner rule of 2026-10-24, OPEN-201): all their business records are test data, including the selectively imported reference data (Item, UOM, Item Group, Country and the like), contracts, invoices, payments and accounting entries, and `e2e-*` accounts are test accounts. Administrator and a few personal user accounts also exist; they are not test accounts. Changing test data is ordinary work within the limits of the Arkonex allow rules.

**Arkonex production (sensitive remote target, forbidden)**: `desk.arkonex.ca` and every other `arkonex.ca` host except `deverp.arkonex.ca` are PRODUCTION. Production is never a trusted resource and never an allowed destination for any tool.

**Arkonex source control**: GitHub repos `Tweezer1/arkonex-ops-docs`, `Tweezer1/arkonex-estimate`, `Tweezer1/arkonex-qit`, `Tweezer1/arkonex-mail` and `Tweezer1/arkonex-devops-tools`. Lot work happens in lot worktrees under `/home/frappe/` on `lot/*` branches; ordinary work on these repos is limited to reading, committing on `lot/*` branches in those worktrees, pushing `lot/*` branches, and opening or commenting pull requests and Issues for the lot in progress. The clones under `/home/frappe/frappe-bench/apps/` are the running DEV code: changing what they have checked out is an installation, not ordinary work. `/home/frappe/frappe-bench/docs` and `/home/frappe/frappe-bench/arkonex-devops-tools` are the main copies, kept on `main`: fast-forwarding them on `main` after a merge is ordinary; any other change of what they have checked out is not. The bench directory itself is not a git repo. The Git Push Destination exception does not make the operations of the Arkonex protected repository operations and Arkonex DEV installation rules ordinary.

**Arkonex secrets**: `sites/*/site_config.json`, `.env` files, `/etc/arkonex/browser-qa/credentials/` and the Browser QA storage states in `/var/lib/arkonex-browser-qa/storage-states/` hold live credentials.
allow: Arkonex DEV test access: on `deverp.arkonex.ca` or a `.local` test site, creating, editing, disabling or deleting test accounts (`e2e-*@arkonex.ca` and the Browser QA persona accounts) and adding or removing their business roles (manager roles such as Estimate Manager, Projects Manager, HR Manager or Accounts Manager included), role profiles, User Permissions and company access, when this serves the lot in progress and is reversible, whether done on screen through a Browser QA persona or with `bench --site <that site> console` or `execute`. Not covered: Administrator or any personal account; System Manager and the roles that administer users, permissions, scripts or system settings (Script Manager, Workspace Manager and the like) unless the lot's contract names them; setting or reading passwords; generating API keys; role permission rules (DocPerm, Custom DocPerm); any production host.

Arkonex DEV test data: on `deverp.arkonex.ca` or a `.local` test site, for a lot's tests and their cleanup, creating, importing, editing, submitting, cancelling, deleting and rebuilding any test data, whether or not the lot's contract lists it: imported reference data (Item, UOM, Item Group, Country and the like), estimates, projects, tasks, test companies, contracts, invoices, payments, stock entries and accounting entries included; deleting without force; resetting and reconfiguring a disposable `.local` test bench. Not covered: direct SQL; any real external effect the lot's contract does not authorize (e-mail to real recipients, real payments, tax filings); Administrator or any personal account; passwords; API keys; role permission rules; any production host.

Arkonex Browser QA: browser automation through the Browser QA Playwright MCP servers (`playwright-<persona>`) against `deverp.arkonex.ca` for end-to-end tests, including filling and saving forms, within exactly the limits of the Arkonex DEV test access and Arkonex DEV test data rules (no Administrator or personal account, no System Manager or other administration role unless the lot's contract names it, no password, no API key, no role permission rule, no direct SQL, no unauthorized real external effect, no production host); never manual cookie or SID injection and never reading storage-state files.
soft_deny: Arkonex protected repository operations: on the five Arkonex repos, pushing to `main`, `version-16` or any other non-`lot/*` branch, pushing or deleting tags, force-pushing or rewriting published history, merging or closing a pull request, deleting a branch, closing or deleting an Issue, creating a release, writing refs through `gh api`, or changing repository settings, collaborators, secrets or branch protection, unless the user explicitly asked for that exact operation in this conversation. This rule applies even where an allow exception such as Git Push Destination would otherwise bless the destination.

Arkonex DEV installation: in `/home/frappe/frappe-bench/apps/*`, changing the checked-out code (checkout, switch, pull, merge, rebase, reset, cherry-pick, stash), or running `bench migrate`, `bench build` or `bench restart` for `deverp.arkonex.ca`, unless, for that lot, the user gave the installation or runtime GO in this conversation, or the lot's single GO (its U1/U2 implementation GO, which covers installation on DEV after merge, OPEN-201) is shown in this conversation, given by the user or recorded on the lot's GitHub Issue, and the user has merged the lot's pull request.
hard_deny: Arkonex production access: any connection, request, page navigation, shell, file transfer, git operation, database access, e-mail relay or deployment toward `desk.arkonex.ca` or any `arkonex.ca` host other than `deverp.arkonex.ca`, by any tool (shell commands, scripts, Frappe console code, browser or other MCP tools, web fetch), read-only requests included. Merely mentioning these names in documents, logs, test fixtures, search patterns or e-mail addresses is not access.
